items.author: yoda-nobunaga.bsky.social
items.context: is a 3 year old too young for stardew valley?
items.text: It's very gentle and you can't really lose, but there's a lot of reading and menus, plus some combat in the mines, so a 3-year-old would probably enjoy sitting with you and watching more than playing.

items.author: goldenhourmaya.bsky.social
items.context: rainy fall afternoon plan: cozy farming game, warm blanket, and a cat on my lap… what's your comfort game this season? 🍂🎮 #gaming #cozy
items.text: That sounds like the perfect afternoon. Dorfromantik fits that mood well: you place tiles to grow a quiet little landscape, no rush at all.
